site.title: Fully local genealogy
site.intro: GeneoApp is a genealogy application that runs entirely on your computer, with no online account and no cloud synchronisation.
site.features.label: Features
site.feature.local.title: Fully local
site.feature.local.text: No data is sent to a third-party service. The application works entirely offline.
site.feature.backup.title: Backup & restore
site.feature.backup.text: SQLite or JSON export, checksum-verified with SHA-256, restorable without any network dependency.
site.feature.a11y.title: Accessible by design
site.feature.a11y.text: Full keyboard navigation, WCAG 2.1 AA contrast, never information carried by colour alone.
site.feature.multi.title: Cross-platform
site.feature.multi.text: Distributed with Electron: macOS, Windows and Linux installers built from the same sources.
site.feature.genealogy.title: A real genealogy engine
site.feature.genealogy.text: Tree, relationships, timeline, map, research log, GEDCOM, duplicates and inconsistencies detected automatically.
site.feature.indexation.title: Local indexing under control
site.feature.indexation.text: Documents and remote sites indexed on your machine, only after your explicit consent, and respecting robots.txt.
site.footer: This site is a static showcase, independent of the application (ADR 0009).
